skill.name: impeccable
skill.description: Designs, audits, and refines production frontend interfaces through structured workflows for accessibility, responsive behavior, visual systems, motion, copy, performance, and live iteration.
skill.summary: Build and refine production frontend interfaces with structured design workflows and live browser tools.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are lexical false positives from design prose, regular-expression calls, readable detector code, and a disclosed minified screenshot dependency. Confirmed risks include automatic network access, disabled browser sandboxing in CI, shell command injection through crafted paths, credential-bearing subprocesses, and a live server whose token and privileged agent workflows are exposed across origins. Static review was capped at 400/2770 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 2370 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The live server exposes its token through unauthenticated live.js under wildcard CORS.
remediation.suggestion: Require authentication before serving tokenized scripts, restrict allowed origins, validate Host and Origin, and avoid placing bearer secrets in readable JavaScript.

remediation.issue: Live copy edits launch AI agents with permission bypass and the complete environment.
remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass flags, use a restricted workspace sandbox, pass an explicit environment allowlist, and require a clear confirmation before each privileged apply.

remediation.issue: The source endpoint uses startsWith for containment and accepts absolute paths.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and use path.relative with component-aware checks after canonicalization. Deny symlink escapes before every read.

remediation.issue: The generated-file check interpolates a path into an execSync shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Use execFileSync with git and an argument array containing check-ignore, --quiet, --, and the absolute path.

remediation.issue: CI browser scans disable Chromium sandbox protections automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Use a hardened CI runner with sandbox support or require explicit opt-in for no-sandbox mode and isolate untrusted pages.

semantic_findings.title: Live Server Exposes Its Bearer Token Across Origins
semantic_findings.description: The loopback server enables wildcard CORS and serves live.js without authentication while embedding the bearer token. Any reachable origin can recover the token and call protected file-reading or source-edit orchestration endpoints.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The request handler explicitly sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin to *, and assembleLiveBrowserScript receives state.token before the unauthenticated response is served.

semantic_findings.title: Browser-Controlled Data Reaches Permission-Bypassed AI Agents
semantic_findings.description: Staged browser text and DOM evidence are embedded in an agent prompt. Codex and Claude then run with approval or permission bypass and inherit the full environment, enabling prompt injection with repository and credential impact.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prompt serializes the staged batch, and the launch arguments explicitly use dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox or bypassPermissions while forwarding env.

semantic_findings.title: Source Endpoint Uses a Prefix-Based Path Boundary Check
semantic_findings.description: The source endpoint accepts absolute paths and checks containment with string startsWith. A sibling path sharing the project directory prefix can pass and expose files outside the project to a token holder.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: path.resolve accepts an absolute input, and startsWith(process.cwd()) is not component-aware. The code does not reject absolute paths before reading.

content.value_statement: Frontend work often lacks consistent design reasoning, accessibility checks, and responsive polish. This skill provides focused workflows that inspect, implement, and refine real interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Builds and refines frontend pages, components, forms, dashboards, and application shells.
Audits accessibility, responsive behavior, visual hierarchy, performance, and common design anti-patterns.
Creates and uses PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context for consistent product and visual decisions.
Runs live browser selection, annotation, screenshot, variant, and staged copy-edit workflows.
Applies command-specific guidance for typography, layout, color, motion, onboarding, and interface copy.
Installs optional post-edit hooks that scan supported frontend files for design issues.
limitations: It is not intended for backend-only tasks or non-interface systems.
Live mode requires a local development page, project configuration, and supported frontend source files.
Live copy editing starts local services and may launch configured AI CLIs with broad repository access.
Automated checks do not replace manual accessibility testing, device testing, or product review.

use_cases.title: Ship a New Product Surface
use_cases.description: Plan and implement a responsive interface that follows existing product context, brand tokens, and component conventions.

use_cases.title: Audit an Existing Interface
use_cases.description: Find accessibility, hierarchy, layout, performance, and responsive issues before release.

use_cases.title: Iterate Visually in the Browser
use_cases.description: Select live elements, annotate desired changes, compare variants, and stage copy edits for source application.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Interface Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the current page for accessibility, hierarchy, spacing, and responsive issues. Prioritize the findings and fix the highest-impact problems.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused quality pass on an existing page.

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Polish the selected component using the existing design system. Improve states, copy, alignment, and mobile behavior without changing its product purpose.
prompt_templates.scenario: A component is functional but visually inconsistent.

prompt_templates.title: Shape and Build a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Shape this feature before implementation. Confirm the user flow, information hierarchy, visual direction, edge cases, and responsive behavior, then build the approved design.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs design reasoning and production implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Run Advanced Live Iteration
prompt_templates.prompt: Start live mode for the target page. Help me select an element, define three identity-consistent variants, compare them, and apply only my approved choice.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user wants browser-guided visual exploration.

output_examples.input: Audit the account settings page before release.
output: Priority: Fix unlabeled controls and insufficient text contrast before release.
Responsive issue: The action row overflows at narrow widths.
Polish item: Align field descriptions and error messages to one spacing scale.

output_examples.input: Make this dashboard quieter without losing hierarchy.
output: Reduced competing accent colors and reserved emphasis for primary actions.
Simplified repeated card treatments while preserving comparison structure.
Adjusted typography and spacing to improve scanning at desktop and mobile sizes.

output_examples.input: Improve onboarding for a first-time workspace owner.
output_examples.output: A revised onboarding flow with clear progress, useful empty states, recovery paths, and responsive implementation aligned with the existing product design.

best_practices: Provide the exact route, component, or file to keep analysis and edits focused.
Keep PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, and committed design tokens current before broad redesign work.
Review live-mode changes and repository diffs before accepting generated variants or copy edits.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for backend-only work or unrelated infrastructure changes.
Do not request a broad redesign without product goals, target users, or an existing interface reference.
Do not accept automated visual output without responsive, accessibility, and interaction testing.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it build new frontend features?
faq.answer: Yes. The craft and shape workflows define the experience, confirm direction, and implement approved frontend code.

faq.question: Can it audit an existing page?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect accessibility, responsiveness, performance, visual hierarchy, and documented design anti-patterns.

faq.question: Does live mode edit source files?
faq.answer: It can inject preview helpers, generate variants, and apply approved staged edits to project source files.

faq.question: Does it require network or command access?
faq.answer: Some workflows use a localhost server, an update check, browser tools, and local AI command-line clients.

faq.question: What should I review before using live copy editing?
faq.answer: Review repository permissions, local service exposure, AI client credentials, staged text, and the final source diff.
